intent: Change and progress over ordered samples as a line or area chart.
useWhen: Following a trajectory across time or sequence
doNotUseWhen: Comparing unrelated magnitudes at one moment — use BarChart

tickInterval.note: draw every Nth axis label; with neither tickInterval nor formatLabel, labels thin automatically only when they would overlap

formatLabel.note: (label, index) => string for the painted axis label; return '' to hide one (turns off automatic thinning). Table and accessible names keep the raw label

animate.note: Lines draw in left to right and area fills fade in after when the chart first appears. Runs when the chart mounts; changing data on a mounted chart does not replay it. To replay (e.g. one chart per Tabs panel, or a range switcher), give the chart a key that changes with the data. Off under prefers-reduced-motion

requirements: animate is decorative only: no motion under prefers-reduced-motion, and hover, focus, legend and table work during the entrance

doNot: Do not invent chart container cousins
snippet: <LineChart title="Weekly active users" variant="area" data={[{ label: 'Mon', value: 1240 }]} />
